title: UV/material carrier on GeometryBundle and textured HalfEdgeMesh rendering
description:
Give the pipeline a home for textures. HalfEdgeMesh and ArrayMesh carry positions and normals only; the only UV notion is the parametric UvField, and the only textured draw path is AssimpModelRuntime's procedural checker. Define the texture data model as GeometryBundle slots: the per-vertex UV slot from CRAW-1 plus a material slot (a plain MaterialData class with public final fields: base-color image bytes/width/height, metallic-roughness image, factors) decoded from the GLB's embedded PNGs through the Platform image loader (stbi_load_from_memory already exists in HeadlessPlatform/LwjglPlatform; expose it on the Platform interface, no LWJGL in graphics). Add a TEXTURED mode to HalfEdgeMeshRuntime that uploads the base-color Texture and samples it via the existing MeshShader useTexture path, falling back to solid colour when the slot is missing. Slots must survive the representation-preserving ops in data/ops (merge_by_distance, delete) or fail loudly. This supersedes the pipeline half of ENG-10 (which targets the render-only Assimp path); the user decides whether ENG-10 is closed as superseded.

Ruling 2026-09-06: (1) texture UVs become a per-corner UvField over a welded mesh (done in CRAW-12's loader rewrite); the TEXTURED renderer must re-split corners when building GPU buffers, and merge_by_distance no longer needs to throw for UVs (the weld map is still wanted for tags and bone weights). (2) Material bytes come from the pure-Java parser result, not Assimp; GltfMaterialReader is rewritten on top of it. (3) Do not keep three stb call sites: loadTexture on the LWJGL and headless platforms reads file bytes and calls decodeImage; Texture gains a constructor from DecodedImage. Rebase onto master after CRAW-12 lands.

Correction 2026-09-06: the texture UV arrives as a UvField on load_mesh's uv output port, not as a bundle slot; the TEXTURED renderer takes (geometry, UvField).

Correction 2026-09-06: the texture UV is the `_uv` slot holding a UvField (CornerUvField); the TEXTURED renderer reads the slot. Ignore the earlier port note.
definition-of-done: 1. Loading a crawfish GLB yields a bundle with UV and material slots; the material slot holds both decoded PNGs. 2. mesh-viewer renders the scan with its own base-color texture (run-scene screenshot shows the photographic crawfish colouring, not the checker). 3. Toggle key in the model scene switches TEXTURED / FLAT / tag modes; ControlHint lists it. 4. Slot names are owned by exactly one constant (on MaterialData / the UV field owner), never raw strings at use sites. 5. join_geometry, transform_geometry, mirror_geometry and merge_by_distance carry the new slots (or throw with a clear message where impossible). 6. Build checkstyle-green; existing mesh tests pass.
testing-plan: 1. Unit test: a two-triangle bundle with a 2x2 RGBA material slot round-trips through transform_geometry and mirror_geometry with UVs intact. 2. Unit test: HalfEdgeMeshRuntime mode selection falls back to solid when no material slot is present (headless GL). 3. run-scene mesh-viewer on IMG_4109.glb, screenshot, visually confirm texture; `ixdar-cli mesh-state` reports the slots. 4. TeaVM build still green (image decode stays behind the platform interface).

DONE : Expose image-from-memory decode on the Platform interface (headless + LWJGL implementations)
DONE : Add TEXTURED mode to HalfEdgeMeshRuntime using the existing Texture and MeshShader useTexture uniform
DONE : Carry UV/material slots through data/ops and the modifier nodes that rebuild bundles
DONE : Add a mode toggle key + ControlHint to ModelScene-based scenes
DONE : Write the two unit tests and the run-scene screenshot check
DONE : Note ENG-10 overlap in changes-made for the user's decision
DONE : Consolidate stb decoding: loadTexture -> decodeImage, Texture(DecodedImage) constructor
DONE : Material slot built from the pure-Java parser's image bytes and factors (after CRAW-12)
DONE : TEXTURED mode re-splits per-corner UVs for GPU upload (after CRAW-12)
DONE : merge_by_distance: expose the weld map, carry tags/bone weights, UVs untouched (per-corner)
unknowns: Per-vertex vs per-corner UVs: glTF is per-vertex, but booleans/quad extraction may need per-corner seams later (CRAW-14)
Whether metallic-roughness should be sampled now or stored only
Whether the material slot should be a Field type per REFACTOR-PLAN-2 C6 or a plain value class (it is not per-element data)

merge_by_distance and the delete ops throw rather than remap the UV slot: MeshMergeByDistance computes the source-to-merged vertex map internally but does not expose it. CRAW-14 will need that map exposed before a welded scan can keep its UVs.
Metallic-roughness is decoded and stored but not sampled; the mesh shader has only the albedoTex/useTexture path. Sampling it needs a PBR fragment shader (not in this ticket).
changes-made: MaterialData value class in geometry/mesh/data owns the '_material' slot: decoded RGBA8 base colour and metallic-roughness images with width/height, baseColorFactor, metallicFactor, roughnessFactor.

UV carrier decided per-vertex: MeshLoader.UV_SLOT moved to a new TextureCoordinates class in geometry/mesh/data (SLOT constant plus of(bundle) accessor), so geometry ops and the renderer read the slot without importing the file loader. The per-corner nodes/api/UvField stays the parametric solver UV and is deliberately not reused.

Platform.decodeImage(byte[]) added, returning a plain DecodedImage (RGBA8 + width/height); HeadlessPlatform and LwjglPlatform delegate to a new StbImageDecoder (stbi_load_from_memory, rows flipped to the GL origin), WebPlatform returns null. No LWJGL enters graphics/ or geometry/.

GltfMaterialReader (desktop-only, next to GltfMeshParser) pulls the embedded base-colour and metallic-roughness PNGs plus baseColorFactor/metallicFactor/roughnessFactor out of the Assimp scene and decodes them through the Platform; GltfMeshParser now emits both the UV and material slots.

HalfEdgeMeshRuntime gained ShaderMode.TEXTURED, uploadBundle(GeometryBundle) (patches per-vertex UVs into the existing interleaved attribute 2 and uploads the base colour through the existing Texture/initGL path), and the static samplesTexture(mode, uploaded) predicate that decides the solid-colour fallback without a GPU.

mesh-viewer loads mesh files with MeshLoader.loadBundle + uploadBundle, auto-selects TEXTURED when a base-colour texture arrives, and Shift+P still cycles every mode (ControlHint 'cycle shader mode' already listed); logState and /ui/state now report shaderMode, baseColorTexture and the sorted slot names.

TextureSlotCarry in data/ops carries the slots: join_geometry concatenates the UVs, mirror_geometry duplicates them for the mirrored half, transform_geometry passes them through unchanged, and merge_by_distance throws a named IllegalStateException when a UV slot would go stale (the weld has no vertex map yet).
Fixed a latent crash in the stb path: stbi_image_free frees memAddress(buffer) = base + position, so the decoded buffer must be rewound after reading or glibc aborts with munmap_chunk.

ENG-10 (Material and Texture Import Support for Mesh Pipeline) is fully superseded on the pipeline path by this ticket; its remaining unique scope is OBJ/MTL external-texture resolution via IXDAR_ASSET_REPO_ROOT on the Assimp render path. Recommend closing it as superseded unless OBJ/MTL materials are still wanted.

Ruling 3 done: stb decoding consolidated to the single StbImageDecoder call site. LwjglPlatform.loadTexture now reads src/main/resources/res/<name> bytes and HeadlessPlatform.loadTexture keeps its classpath read; both call decodeImage. Texture gained Texture(String, DecodedImage) (copies into a native-order direct buffer) and is the only caller of the ByteBuffer constructor; WebPlatform.loadTexture, AssimpModelRuntime's procedural checker and HalfEdgeMeshRuntime's base-colour upload all go through it. Verified byte-identical: all 10 res images decode to the same width/height/bytes as the old inline stbi_load, and the mesh-boolean ESC-menu screenshot (font text) is the same PNG sha256 before and after. The window-icon stbi_load in IxdarWindow is left alone: it must NOT be vertically flipped and needs a live native buffer for GLFWImage.

Rebased onto master 725a711d (CRAW-12 + CRAW-21). Conflicts in GltfMeshParser, LoadMeshNode, GltfMeshParserTest and CrawfishScanLoadBenchmark resolved by taking master wholesale; MeshLoader and MeshNodeViewerScene resolved to master plus the CRAW-3 lines only.

TextureCoordinates deleted: the UV slot is CornerUvField.SLOT from CRAW-12, per corner over the welded mesh. MaterialData keeps its class (it has SLOT, of(bundle) and hasBaseColorTexture()) and its fields are already plain arrays and scalars, so it passes the thin-data-class rule.

GltfMaterialReader rebuilt on GltfMeshParser.read()'s GltfModel arrays: picks the first material with a baseColorTexture, resolves baseColorTexture/metallicRoughnessTexture through textureImage to imageBytes, decodes via Platform.decodeImage, and copies baseColorFactor/metallicFactor/roughnessFactor. No Assimp anywhere; TeaVM links it and simply gets null pixels back on the web.

MeshLoader.loadBundle now returns UV plus material for glTF (GltfMaterialReader.loadBundle); MeshLoader.load takes a new geometry-only glTF path so a caller that wants just the mesh does not pay for decoding a scan's textures.

HalfEdgeMeshRuntime TEXTURED mode re-splits per-corner UVs with CornerUvSplit into its own VAO/VBO/EBO, drawn only in TEXTURED; the welded buffers stay behind tag ranges, the wireframe and the scalar attribute. samplesTexture(mode, texturedDrawReady) is still the one fallback decision and hasTexturedDraw() reports both halves being resident.

ModelCollection's LRU cache holds GeometryBundle instead of ArrayMesh (parsedBundles / loadBundle / cacheBundle / isBundleCached), so stepping through collection members keeps each scan's UV and material slots and the viewer stays textured.

MeshMergeByDistance gained an instance form: new MeshMergeByDistance().weld(mesh, distance) fills public weldedVertex (source vertex -> merged vertex) and sourceFace (output face -> input face) on both the dense and half-edge paths; the old statics still work for callers that do not need the maps.

TextureSlotCarry became SlotCarry and now carries every per-element slot: join concatenates corner UVs, mirror reverses each face's corners for the mirrored half, and weld re-indexes corner UVs by sourceFace, ORs _tags and takes the first source's _bone_weight_* per merged vertex. The merge_by_distance UV throw is gone; join and mirror log when a weld changes the face count and the UVs cannot follow.

Verified: 194 unit tests with only the pre-existing DenseMeshFewSplitsTest failure; checkstyle green; TeaVM BUILD SUCCESS with no StbImageDecoder, stbi_load_from_memory, Assimp or Gson in classes.js; run-scene on 47863 loads IMG_4109.glb as verts=468350 faces=936035 slots=_material,_uv shader=TEXTURED, and the screenshot is RMSE 7.1e-5 against the pre-rebase textured render (visually identical).

join_geometry and mirror_geometry now weld through the recording MeshMergeByDistance and re-index their corner UVs with SlotCarry.weldCornerUv, so a textured mesh keeps its UVs through mirror_geometry's default seam weld too. No op drops or throws for UVs any more; unit tests cover the mirror-with-weld and merge-with-weld cases.

Ticket unknowns resolved: per-vertex vs per-corner is settled as per-corner (CRAW-12's CornerUvField); merge_by_distance no longer throws because the weld map is exposed and per-corner UVs follow the faces. Still open and unchanged: metallic-roughness is decoded and stored but not sampled (needs a PBR fragment shader).

Cost note: MeshLoader.loadBundle now decodes a glTF's embedded textures, and ModelCollection caches whole bundles, so up to MAX_CACHED_MEMBERS members hold their decoded RGBA (about 32 MB per crawfish scan at 2048 square). MeshLoader.load keeps a geometry-only glTF path for callers that only want the mesh.
